name: DeepWiki
summary: Free, no-authentication wiki and Q&A over any public GitHub repository with repo structure, docs, and grounded answers.
description: DeepWiki's hosted MCP server over Streamable HTTP (https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp). Reads the generated wiki structure and contents for public repositories and answers questions grounded in the repo. No key required.
